# AIBfamily — family mode for AIBs (in development)
> Parents see what they need. Children keep their privacy. AIBfamily is in development and being built on AIB.core, the engine behind AIBEVA.

## Key facts
- Status: in development. Not yet available.
- Every family member has their own intelligent being; only what is explicitly allowed is shared.
- Safe by design, with the Guardian layer (AIBguardian) inside; designed with the EU AI Act and GDPR in mind.
- Contact: info@aiblab.info
- AIBEVA (for adults, 18+) is free for Windows today: https://aibeva.com/download
- Operator: SAY TO PAY s.r.o. (AIBlab), Ostrava, Czech Republic, EU · Company ID 086 94 222
